hero_eyebrow: Podcast & Content Studio · Den 1880 · Uptown Waterloo
hero_subhead: Built inside a former 1900s bond safe, where 12-inch steel walls do the soundproofing. Book it by the hour and walk out with multi-camera video and broadcast audio — no crew to hire, no kit to set up. $95/hr, or $76 if you're a member.
hero_proof_quote: “I’ve visited for events, podcast recording, and coworking, and every time it has been an incredible experience.”
about_intro: The Vault is housed inside Den 1880's original 1900s bank vault, a space with 12-inch steel-reinforced walls that provides natural soundproofing unlike any purpose-built studio. The history inside these walls is as compelling as the content recorded here.
specs_intro: Everything you need for a professional production, ready to go.
gallery_subhead: Shot in the studio itself — the desk, the mics, the vault door that gives the room its acoustics.
testi_intro: One of Den 1880’s reviews names the studio; most are about the wider building. All three below are verbatim, and the tag on each says what that person actually used — so you can weigh them yourself.
testi_1_quote: “Incredible space for daily work or events, with an inspiring and very unique ambiance… everything from the event space, to library, private booths, podcast studio, kitchens and offices is very well put together and versatile.”
testi_2_quote: “The best co-working space in Waterloo. Andrew’s team has transformed this building into an exceptional venue. Better than any WeWork I’ve been to.”
testi_3_quote: “Den 1880 is a phenomenal workspace — its gorgeous, functional, and a great place to get deep work done! The staff was very friendly, and extremely helpful!”
about_banner_intro: Den 1880 is Uptown Waterloo's premium coworking space, with a private gym, recovery amenities, boutique event venue, and The Vault, all under one heritage roof. Members record here regularly. You can too.
